name: save-files-as-zip
description: Right-click files or folders in VS Code or code-server and download them as a zip archive.

saveFilesAsZip.tempDirectory.markdownDescription: Directory used for short-lived zip files before browser download. Relative paths resolve from the selected files' common parent. Absolute paths are allowed; in browser-only VS Code Web they must be writable through the active workspace file-system provider. In VS Code Web and code-server the download goes through the Explorer, so the directory must be inside the workspace and not hidden by `files.exclude`.

saveFilesAsZip.excludeNames.markdownDescription: File and folder names left out of every zip, at any depth. The default keeps out the Coursera lab's `.dotfiles-coursera` folder, which holds saved Git credentials, VS Code settings, and every installed extension.

scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.desktop.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && node --check scripts/build.js && node --check scripts/smoke-web-download.js
